lesson_title: Hammer It, Stretch It, Shine It
hook_text: Gold can be hammered so thin that light shines through it.
clip_script: Three kilometres under Johannesburg, miners once dug out rock with gold inside. Back at school: a steel nail you cannot scratch. Shiny, hard, strong. A lead sinker that flattens under a hammer instead of shattering. Malleable! A copper rod pulled into thin wire. Ductile! A spoon in a candle flame that does not melt. And all of it dug from the Earth as ore. Metals: South Africa is full of them.
visual_style: Whiteboard mine shaft dropping down, then four quick tests: scratch, hammer, stretch and flame.
mood: Adventurous, like going underground with a headlamp.
pacing: Mine opener, four fast property tests, then back to the ore in the rock.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find five metal objects in your home.
